sloka: प्रहर्षिताः केतक पुष्प गन्धम्आघ्राय मत्ता वन निर्झरेषु ।प्रपात शब्द आकुलिता गजेन्द्राःसार्धम् मयूरैः स मदा नदन्ति ॥४-२८-२८॥
transliteration: praharṣitāḥ ketaka puṣpa gandhamāghrāya mattā vana nirjhareṣu ।prapāta śabda ākulitā gajendrāḥsārdham mayūraiḥ sa madā nadanti ॥4-28-28॥

translations.english: 'The lordly elephants get intoxicated with the fragrance of ketaki flowers, the noise of waterfalls and the cackle of peacocks and they give out a shrill trumpet.
